title: Seeming great is not being great
summary: Let your own heart, work, and remembrance come back into view. Let this stay near the next choice: let this stay with you: choose the Lord's measure of greatness and refuse Maya's scale.
takeaway: Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
lifeApplication: When envy rises, step away from the screen and return the mind to one truthful task already in your hands today.

source.shortMeaning: What seems great can still be only seeming.
source.lifeApplication: When power dazzles you, interrupt the spell of seeming greatness.
